verdict.rationale: Zulip's channel docs show a distinct guest role with restricted access: guests, unlike everyone else, cannot subscribe to any public or web-public channel on their own. The self-hosting page also mentions advanced roles and permissions. That implies guest accounts with limited access exist, but the evidence only touches this in passing. Missing for 10: documentation on inviting and managing guest accounts, how admins grant guests specific channels, shared or cross-organization channels, and any independent or hands-on evidence of partner collaboration.
